title: Regime manager: fix the 2 stale atmosphere fixtures — full suite green
description: The TASK-25 regime state machine (space/atmosphere/surface with anti-flap hysteresis, server per-tick resolution with flightRegime on the wire, client controls remap + 500 ms divergence tracker, and all 5 of its test files) is implemented and committed. The ONLY unmet TASK-25 acceptance criterion is 'npm run test green': two tests in app/src/server/shard/shard.test.ts (describe 'SystemShard regime context (TASK-13 step 2, atmosphere)') fail because their fixtures spawn ships ~10 km from the planet anchor (10000, 0), so the new per-tick resolveRegime (src/server/shard/shard.ts) correctly resolves them to 'space' (no gravity). Fix both fixtures so the ships start INSIDE the atmosphere (d < 1000 u of the anchor), make the full unit suite green, and commit. Do NOT change the regime machine, its constants, or resolveRegime to make the tests pass.

steps.description: Fix fixture 'integrates atmosphere ships against chunk-cached terrain (O(1) heightAt)' (app/src/server/shard/shard.test.ts, line ~361)
steps.details: planetAnchor(0) is (10000, 0) (src/shared/galaxy/planets.ts); enter radius = ATMOSPHERE_BOUNDARY_M = 1000 u, exit = 1050 u (REGIME_EXIT_FACTOR 1.05). The ship currently spawns at (40, startY, 40) → d ≈ 10000 u → regime flips to 'space' on tick 1 → no gravity → the 'fell' assertion fails. Move the spawn to (10040, startY, 40) — d ≈ 155–160 u at spawn, inside the atmosphere, and the straight-down fall keeps shrinking d. Probe the height with new TerrainContext(SEED, planet) at (10040, 40) instead of (40, 40) (the final ground probe already uses the ship's actual final x/z — keep it). Keep the entity's initial regime 'atmosphere' + planetId (makeEntity already sets it), the pure-gravity input script (thrust 0), and both assertions (pos.y < startY; pos.y >= ground - 1e-6, no tunneling). Verify with: cd app && npx vitest run src/server/shard/shard.test.ts

steps.description: Fix fixture 'VTOL lift (action: vtol) settles a ship on the pad' (same file, line ~397)
steps.details: The pad currently comes from chunk (0,0) (terrain.update(0, 0)) — ~10 km from the anchor → same space-resolution failure (ship drifts at constant vel.y = -5, onPad never set). Chunks are CHUNK_SIZE × CELL_SIZE_M = 64 × 5 = 320 m (src/shared/galaxy/surface.ts); the anchor (10000, 0) sits in chunk (31, 0). Replace the setup: terrain.update(10000, 0) (or a nearby point) so the cached 3×3 neighborhood covers the anchor, then pick the pad from terrain.pads() that is CLOSEST to (10000, 0). Pads are seeded at a 25% per-chunk roll on landable planets (forced only in chunk (0,0)), so if the cached neighborhood has no pad, deterministically walk nearby 320 m steps in a fixed order (bump terrain.update point) until terrain.pads() is non-empty. Spawn at (pad.x, ground + 10, pad.z) — inside the atmosphere. Keep the existing two-phase input script (40 ticks no lift, then 100 ticks action:'vtol') and ALL assertions, including the docked snapshot regime (entityToState reports 'docked' once the ship settles on the pad — it will, once the ship is in the atmosphere). Verify with the same targeted command.

cd app && npm run test → ALL green (≈652 tests, 0 failures — this is the 'npm run test green' acceptance criterion of TASK-25). cd app && npm run typecheck → clean. cd app && npm run lint → clean (eslint + prettier --check). Then commit (Conventional Commit, e.g. 'test(TASK-25): spawn atmosphere fixtures inside the planet atmosphere (d < 1000 u of anchor); full suite green') and stop — one task per iteration.

acceptanceCriteria: Both previously failing tests in app/src/server/shard/shard.test.ts — 'integrates atmosphere ships against chunk-cached terrain (O(1) heightAt)' and 'VTOL lift (action: vtol) settles a ship on the pad' — pass, with the ships spawned inside the atmosphere (d < 1000 u of anchor (10000, 0)) and their original assertions otherwise unchanged
